title: otel/pyproject.toml's prometheus exporter floor is the release that pairs with the SDK 1.39 floor
goal: otel/pyproject.toml's opentelemetry-exporter-prometheus floor is the first release whose sdk pin admits opentelemetry-sdk 1.39 and whose PrometheusMetricReader takes registry=, read from that release's metadata, re-locked with uv lock --project otel

run: import re,sys;m=re.search(r'opentelemetry-exporter-prometheus>=0\.([0-9]+)',open('otel/pyproject.toml',encoding='utf-8').read());v=int(m[1]) if m else 0;print('prometheus exporter floor 0.%db0'%v);sys.exit(0 if v>=60 else 1)
